blocks.text: Deadline on Monday launched the streaming site for Contenders Film Los Angeles, its showcase of movies making noise this awards season.
The live event Saturday at the DGA Theater spotlighted 15 films from eight studios and streamers.

blocks.text: This year’s lineup included everything from box office blockbusters like Project Hail Mary and Toy Story 5 to festival favorites hits like Bunker, The Liberation, Tuner, Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother and The Only Living Pickpocket in New York ; animated films like Wildwood, Hexed, Hoppers and The Violinist ; fact-based depictions I Play Rocky, Being Heumann and Tenzing ; and a decidedly less fact-based hit in Wicker .

Among the stars and creatives participating in panel conversations at the all-day gathering were Penélope Cruz, John Turturro, Tatiana Maslany, Mahershala Ali, John Cho, Phil Lord and Chris Miller, Anthony Ippolito, AnnaSophia Robb, Ruth Madeley, Jennifer Peedom, Luke Davies, Travis Knight, Piper Curda, Carrie Coon, Lily James and Alexander Skarsgård.

In addition, I Play Rocky ‘s Peter Farrelly was feted with Deadline’s Contenders Hall of Fame Award , while Danny Boyle received the Deadline Legend Award as he discussed (and broke some news ) about his latest film Ink .

blocks.text: Distributors taking part in Contenders L.A. were Amazon MGM Studios, Apple Original Films, Black Bear, Bleecker Street, Disney/Pixar, Laika, Robot Playground Media, Sony Pictures Classics and Walt Disney Animation Studios.
Up next on Deadline’s event calendar are Contenders Film International and Contenders Film Documentary , virtual presentations set to stream December 5 and December 6, respectively.
